units.source_text: “征兵检查时是四尺九寸九，后来又长了三分，成了五尺二分。

en.t: “At the conscription physical I was four feet nine inches and nine-tenths; later I grew another three-tenths of an inch, making me five feet and two-tenths.

units.source_text: 上了年纪，人也萎缩了，现在是五尺整。”

en.t: As I got older, my body shrank too, and now I am exactly five feet.”
